title: docs(pm-dispatch, os-dev): a finding files only with measured reachability; same-family findings fold into one class-closure card; triage gates unproven ones to p3
body:
Fixes #20088

Clause-②: no

Every path in this diff is under `.claude/**` (Tier S): the PR stays a draft, is not readied, queued or armed by any seat, and lands only on a contract-tier review of record. It publishes nothing from any package `files[]`, so it carries `skip-changeset`.

## What changed — one rule, four sites, written as shapes

The maintainer's ruling on the card (triage seat chat, 2026-09-25, verbatim): the triage seat answered 「立卡时由发现者确认,分诊只把关、不测量」 and the maintainer said 「同意」. The three numbered clauses of the card's 裁决内容 are implemented as written, at the four sites the card names. No card numbers appear in the operational text (`check:pm-skill-id-lint` refuses them there); the two precedents the card asks for are written as shapes.

- **`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` rule 3 — the finder.** Every (a)(b)(c) finding carries a `reach:` entry: one measured wrong answer at a public door (HTTP / UI / `os validate` / save), or one named real producer. Read-only inference is listed among what is not a card and goes to `## Acceptance notes` with `carrier:`. The three exceptions still report — possible data exposure, wrong text that a release would freeze, maintainer-directed — with `reach:` naming which. A same-family finding is pointed at the family's class-closure card in the report instead of a second single-site card; the definition lives in the pm-dispatch 报告契约. The report JSON's `out_of_scope_findings` example line gains the `reach:` field (one edited line inside the fence; nothing else in the block moved).
- **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 报告契约 — the seat.** `reach:` is required on every entry; no measurement ⇒ no card, with the exceptions and the definition at 立卡门 ①; the reports of one round are cross-read and a family opens one card. The class-closure card is defined once here: one card covering every site of the family, one pin that enumerates the sites; when none exists, the second occurrence opens it. The four-axis block (:241–:261) is byte-unchanged (md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0` before and after).
- **`references/triage-duties.md` — the gate.** All three classes owe `reach:`; triage gates and does not measure. Missing evidence and not an exception ⇒ `priority:p3`, folded into the closure or sweep card, never dispatched alone, and triage never takes the card off the board for that reason (关卡归维护者). The old 「同族异缺陷 ⛔ 不并:互链排同批」 sentence is replaced for findings; in-flight cards (assignee / open PR) are still never merged, `Blocked-by:` is still not dispatched, completion still re-checks staleness.
- **`references/filing-gate.md` ① — the definition.** A `finding` inside ① is limited to the three classes AND carries `reach:`; the two accepted forms; the three exceptions, whose first execution item is 「先测可达性」; and the two precedents as shapes — a card whose body itself says 未测量 is not filed (Acceptance notes with a carrier); a card recording one measured wrong answer at a public door is filed.

Not done, by the card's own terms: no new `check-*` gate; no retroactive re-triage of existing cards; the 过渡期 sentence stays as the card states it (triage already runs clause ③; clauses ① and ② take effect for the other seats when this lands); `.claude/settings.json` untouched.

## Ratchet payment — every file stays at its ceiling, paid inside its own section

| file | lines before | lines after | ceiling |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 402 | 402 | 402 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 319 | 319 | 319 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` | 120 | 120 | 120 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md` | 58 | 58 | 58 |

Every prose line is at most 120 bytes; no re-wrap was used as payment. What paid, and why it is equal-or-lower value:

- os-dev.md — 「(a) 须今天可达,分错误与不完整…示例照抄即失败是 (a),漏列成员不是」 is subsumed by `reach:` (copying the example is a measured wrong answer at the authoring door; a missing member measures nothing) and survives verbatim for the triage seat at triage-duties :44; 风格/nit left the not-a-card list (抛光 covers them) to make room for 只读推断; the pointer line to `rest-channel.md` is deleted (the dev's four writes go through `scripts/pm/` tools that choose the route; the table is the seat's); the two dedupe lines are merged, dropping 「预算外零写」 (it restates the four-write budget beside it) and 「只复核其后增量」 (it contradicted 「dev ⛔ 不查重」).
- SKILL.md — the JSON-shape pointer and the `needs_decision` line are merged; the twin-card cross-read line is replaced by the fold rule, which carries 「同轮报告互读」.
- triage-duties.md — the instrument line is deleted: it duplicates `instrument-discipline.md` :6 and :8 verbatim, reached through :41's pointer to the filing gate's ⛔ list.
- filing-gate.md — 「原为首触即关,今门前即拒」 (history, not a rule) is dropped from the 三类外 line, which now also names the unmeasured `finding`; the 丢卡重建 and sweep-reminder lines are merged; the fleet-identity line is deleted as a verbatim duplicate of SKILL.md :94 (全体座位的不变量). **Re-merge (head `247e355d`, after PR #20108 landed):** the write-pacing line this branch first paid with had been REPLACED on `main` by #20108's 「十张一组只备下一组…」 rule, which is kept verbatim; the payment moved to the ⛔-list row 「⛔ 不是卡:仪器误报与门禁假读数(不派 dev 见 `references/instrument-discipline.md`)。」, whose rule lives verbatim at `references/instrument-discipline.md` :6 / :8 and stays reachable from `references/reading-discipline.md` :26. Three-dot diff unchanged: 4 files, +21 / −21; 58 / 58.

## Deviations from the dispatch, measured

- 「先测可达性」 as the first execution item is written at the filing gate ① (the seat's definition) and pointed at from SKILL.md, not in os-dev.md: the dev never writes a card body (os-dev.md rule 3, 「dev 不 `POST /issues`」), so the sentence has no reader there. os-dev.md carries the exceptions as the finder's reporting duty (`reach:` names which).
- The dispatch named os-dev.md :41–:60 as this card's region; rule 3 runs to :67. Every edit sits inside :45–:60.
- The four sites sat exactly where the dispatch cited them on `origin/main` `8d76c2d` (identical to `d624002` for these paths). Same-day churn: nothing landed on the four paths after the branch point; `origin/main` moved once (`aa04ea29`, objectql) with no overlap.

## Verification

Gate families derived from the real change set (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, no paths, three-dot against merge base `8d76c2d`), all run at head `b985bd39`, each exit captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: 23 derived, 23 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero — every family recorded its exit code).

- exit 0: `check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` (gate and `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` (7156 files, 0 disagree), `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` (279 cases), `check-harness-current.mjs --self-test` (26 cases), `check:agent-model-declared`, `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:commit-card-trailers` (also run by the pre-push hook: 1 commit, no card relation, no model identifier), `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-expected-skips`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-governed-prose` (2 surfaces name all 6 governed surfaces), `check:pm-half-states` (4912 cases), `check:pm-skill-id-lint` (34 files clean), `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (157 self-test cases; the four files at 402/319/120/58 against ceilings 402/319/120/58), `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:skill-frame-sync` (one declared copy, coherent), `check:watch-hint-literal`.
- exit 0: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` — its prerequisite, the closure `@objectstack/lint...` (spec, formula, sdui-parser, lint), was built under the shared verify lock (`os-verify-lock.sh` VERDICT command-exit 0, held 203s, 4/4 turbo tasks); 22 record-scoped examples across 456 files judged clean.
- exit 0, outside the derivation: `check:skill-frame-freshness` (the frame is current with `origin/main`).
- Not owed and not run: no package source changed, so no `pnpm test` / `pnpm typecheck` closure; `pnpm lint` is CI's run.

## Acceptance notes

No out-of-scope findings. The (a) boundary lesson (示例照抄即失败是 (a),漏列成员不是) now lives only at triage-duties :44; under `reach:` the same question is answered by measurement.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 四处协议文本改成同一条规则:发现者立卡前先测可达性 —— 公开入口(HTTP、界面、`os validate` 或保存)实测出一次错误结果,或点名一个已存在的真实生产者 —— 写进 `reach:` 一栏;只读代码推断不立卡,进 PR 的 Acceptance notes 并带承接者。三种例外(可能泄露数据、随发版固化的错误文字、维护者直派)未测量也照立,执行要点第一条写「先测可达性」。同族发现并入该族收口卡(一张卡覆盖全部位置、带一个能枚举全部位置的钉子),不再逐点开卡。分诊只把关不测量:缺可达性证据又非例外的定 p3、并入收口卡或清扫卡,不单独派发,也不因此关卡。

**为什么改** — 维护者在分诊席会话的裁决(2026-09-25,逐字):维护者问「理论上的问题建议时分诊时确认还是立卡时确认?」,分诊席答「立卡时由发现者确认,分诊只把关、不测量」,维护者:「同意」。分诊席的读数:一夜 55 张新卡全部来自 dev 报告的顺路发现,大量卡面自注「未测量」,同一缺陷族连环立卡,开放卡数持平 —— 修复速度赶不上顺路发现的速度。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 风险:未测量的 (b) 类发现不再成卡,只留在 PR 的 Acceptance notes,若承接者为无则可能被遗忘;三种例外兜住安全、发版固化与直派。代价:四个文件都在行数上限,每条新句都以删掉一条被新规则涵盖或在别处逐字重复的旧句付账(清单在上文 Ratchet payment 节);没有新增门禁、脚本或数据变化。回滚:revert 本 PR 的单个 commit 即可,四个文件回到原样。

**席位意见** — (留空,由席位定稿成评论)

**你要做的** — 本 PR 只改 `.claude/**`(Tier S),保持 draft;席内契约复核记录 PASS 后由席位入队落地,不需要维护者的合并点击。维护者只需确认:第 1、2 条从本 PR 落地起对其他席位生效;第 3 条分诊席已按过渡期条款先行执行。
